applicability: T031 bounded local-IPC-only tool gateway candidate
statement: The gateway and its tests **shall** be offline and local-only: only the C++ standard library, the T030 generated Protocol Buffers message library, the accepted in-process T021-T029 libraries, and GTest; no network, `AF_INET`/`AF_INET6`, DNS, resolver, TLS, ambient/secret, dynamic-load, subprocess, or legacy access and no new admitted dependency.
title: T031 requirement 018
